chequeos.detalle: the 82 files of the package (lib64/libndk_translation.so + 20 arm64 proxy libs + the ARM-side lib64/arm64 tree + bin/arm64/{app_process64,linker64} + cpuinfo/ld.config .txt) are verified against their sha256 before injecting

taken from x86_64-35-ext15_r01.zip (md5 of libndk_translation.so: fa52951394226cbcc52e666f1d8c0d19); the earlier builds served by r06-r09/ext14 (md5 3f1d2639...) crash deterministically inside the translator on Unity IL2CPP games -- see docs/COMPATIBILITY.md of redroid-ndk-translation for how this was traced by source-line fingerprint

Loop Sort (com.Garawell.LoopSort, arm64-only, Unity IL2CPP) installs, boots and is playable past level 4 with the full official 82-file set, hardware encoder active at 20 Mbps -- no crash in libndk_translation.so, unlike the r09/ext14 build

validaciones.notas: pvz2 (com.ea.game.pvz2_row, arm64) installs and runs with the older r09/ext14 build (does not crash the way Loop Sort does), but was not yet tried specifically with this ext15 package -- pending.

problemasConocidos.descripcion: The Android SDK system images carry no 32-bit translator: apps that are armeabi-v7a-only (no arm64-v8a variant) are not covered by this module.
Translated native code runs slower than native x86_64: expect roughly 2x-5x more CPU time in the app's native part.

The translator is Google's, under the Android SDK license, and is never hosted or redistributed by redroid-forge or this database -- the user downloads the system image themselves and the module verifies it by hash before injecting.
